guideRule1: One rule per line, relative to the data directory, for example /assets/ or /assets/*.pdf.
guideRule2: Lines starting with # are comments, ! negates a rule, * matches any characters and ** matches nested directories.
guideRule3: Start rules with / so look-alike paths elsewhere are not matched; use /folder/ to exclude a whole directory.
guideRule4: Use / as the path separator; the kernel treats a backslash as a regex escape, and a wrong one disables the whole rule.
guideRule5: The file may contain rules written by other tools; this plugin never rewrites them. Saved rules take effect on the next sync.
placeholder: One rule per line, for example /assets/*.pdf
saved: Saved, the rules take effect on the next sync
saveUnverified: The saved content could not be read back, please reopen and check it
discardText: Your changes will be lost after closing.
conflictText: The sync ignore file was modified by SiYuan or another tool while you were editing. Saving now overwrites those changes.
bomNotice: This file starts with a UTF-8 BOM; the kernel treats it as part of the first rule and silently disables it. Saving removes the BOM.
lintInvalidEscape: Line {line} has an invalid backslash escape, the kernel skips this rule
lintUnclosedClass: Line {line} has an unclosed [, the kernel skips this rule
lintUnbalancedGroup: Line {line} has unbalanced parentheses, the kernel skips this rule
lintBadRepetition: Line {line} misuses + or {…}, the kernel skips this rule
lintStarInClass: Line {line} has a * inside a character class, the kernel skips this rule
lintBadClassRange: Line {line} has a reversed character class range, the kernel skips this rule
lintEmptyNegation: Line {line} is only ! with no rule, which cancels every earlier rule
lintMore: {count} more lines make the kernel skip rules
